facts.quote: The assertions are evaluated by Gemini-2.5-Pro ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) using screenshots captured before and after the action.
facts.note: IWR-Bench IFS: a Browser-Use-based executor replays the ground-truth trajectory, GPT-4o grounds the natural-language action descriptions to page elements, Gemini-2.5-Pro evaluates the assertions

facts.quote: The High-level Fidelity Score (HFS) is assigned by Gemini-2.5-Pro through holistic comparison of the generated and reference screenshots.
For Vision2Web, the visual judge is instantiated with Gemini-3-Pro-Preview.
facts.note: visual judge of the Vision2Web scores
